_how: Viste a Klaudia: the outfit menu (labels as buttons, or a numbered sheet made with klaudia_sheet.py pick). Paste the chosen look's 'text' after her identity; a look with a 'ref' also sends that picture as image 2 (the clothes only). 🔄 more options = 3 new outfits that fit the story; ✍️ my own = the person describes it or sends a photo of clothes (never a real person's face): the first approved still of her in it is cropped into image 2 (klaudia_photo.py outfit). Never clothes that hide her face or change her hair.

looks.label: 🎙 Her news look (default)
looks.text: She wears exactly her outfit from the reference images: white blouse with puffed sleeves, black corset, short silver sequin skirt, white gloves, white high boots.

looks.label: 🤍 White latex catsuit
looks.text: She wears a glossy white latex catsuit with thin orange piping and a high collar, white gloves and white boots; no dress, no black clothes.

looks.label: 🖤 Dark gala dress
looks.text: She wears an elegant floor-length dark evening gown, simple and fitted, with small orange earrings.

looks.label: 💚 Green satin dress
looks.text: She wears a fitted emerald-green satin cocktail dress with thin straps and small orange earrings.

looks.label: 🎲 Whatever fits the news
looks.text: Choose clothes that fit the story's world, high fashion and unmistakably her style (white, black, silver or orange); say which.
